主要内容: Susquehanna Financial Group, LLLP (SFG) announced the hiring of Christopher Rolland as a senior analyst covering the Semiconductor industry. Rolland will be based in SFG's New York office. Nick Wood, SFG's Co-Head of Equities, stated that Rolland's addition will provide a unique global perspective for the semiconductor market, combining his expertise with Mehdi Hosseini's analysis. Akir Gutierrez, SFG Director of Research, highlighted Rolland's value-added approach and his potential to expand the firm's technology vertical. Prior to joining SFG, Rolland was a Senior Vice President at FBR & Co covering semiconductors and previously worked as a buy-side equity analyst and trader at Opus Capital. Rolland holds an MBA from Columbia Business School and a B.A. in Economics from Denison University. SFG is an innovator in global finance, offering services in sales, fundamental research, and market intelligence, with a focus on liquidity and execution services. SIG employs approximately 1,800 individuals globally.
